BadRequest.description: Malformed JSON body or If-Match header (invalid_json, invalid_precondition, invalid_upload).

Conflict.description: Duplicate name or key, or another state constraint (conflict).

Forbidden.description: The caller lacks the required permission (forbidden).

InternalServerError.description: Unexpected server error (internal_error); the request ID locates the log entry.

NotFound.description: The entity does not exist or is not visible to the caller (not_found).

RequestEntityTooLarge.description: Request body exceeds the size limit (payload_too_large).

ServiceUnavailable.description: Server at capacity or read time limit reached, retry after Retry-After (overloaded, timeout), or not ready (unavailable).

UnprocessableEntity.description: Request failed schema or business validation (validation_failed); errors lists schema failures.

code.description: Stable machine-readable problem code, e.g. not_found, conflict, validation_failed, precondition_required.

errors.description: Request fields that failed schema validation.

operation_index.description: Zero-based failing operation index for bulk item errors. Omitted for batch-wide errors.

request_id.description: Also returned as the X-Request-ID header.

type.description: Always about:blank; code identifies the problem.

location.description: Where the error occurred, e.g. body.name or query.limit.

info.description:
One organization per SQLite deployment. Immutable schema/content revisions, SharePoint-style exclusive permission scopes, head/published projections, rich typed fields, reusable templates, saved queries, taxonomy, and typed relationships. Libraries with webdav_enabled are also served over WebDAV (RFC 4918 class 1 and 2) at /webdav/{libraryID}/, outside this contract; WebDAV accepts these bearer tokens or HTTP Basic with a WebDAV credential password.

This document is generated from the Go handlers (`go generate ./internal/httpapi`); do not edit it by hand.
